title: Andrea Kirby
intro: Andrea Kirby (Working Class Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Michigan's 10th Congressional District. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the Working Class Party convention on June 6, 2026.
